{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|alcohol|the [[Bedlam Spirits]]}}
{{Quote|Spirits muddle the mind, slow the body, nourish nothing but weakness.|[[Dannik Jerriko]]|<ref name="Soup's On: The Pipe Smoker's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Soup's On: The Pipe Smoker's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
'''Spirit''', or '''spirits''', referred to strong [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages, like [[Wine/Legends|wine]]<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref><ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> and [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]]. A distinction was made between spirits and [[beer]].<ref name="GG9" /> Spirits were made through processes of distillation, brewing and/or fermentation.<ref name="Death Star novel">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> Some types of spirits, like [[Tihaar/Legends|tihaar]], were made from [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'' glossary</ref><ref name="The Mandalorians: People and Culture">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> Spirits were often stores in casks or barrels.<ref name="The Farrimmer Cafe">{{JournalCite|11|The Farrimmer Cafe}}</ref>

[[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] had a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] that mixed sixteen hundred varieties of spirits.<ref name="Soup's On: The Pipe Smoker's Tale" />
